units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:23">Koh. R. to VII, 23</cite> <he>רגלוי … לח׳ דנונא</he> the feet of chickens resemble (as to their covering) the scale-covered skin of the fish, v. <cite ref="H01737"><he>חַרְסְפִיתִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 133b">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>האי מאן דמשי … ליה ח׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>חוספנתא</he>) he who washes his face and does not dry it well, will get a scab.
